About the Creator

Abdullah Aboelhamd
Medical student · Web developer

I’m 19, a second-year medical student at the Faculty of Medicine, Ain Shams University, and a web developer working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Node.js.

MedLuxury is my own project — I designed and built it from scratch, every screen and every line of code.

It’s a sadaqah jariyah for my sister, Fatima Alzahraa, released for Batch 79. Please remember her in your prayers.

It is freely given, and my only request is that it be received with appreciation rather than entitlement — the latter genuinely weighs on me.

MedLuxury · Premium medical learning · All your data stays on your device.
